summaries.full-stack-jobgether: Full Stack Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, and scalable microservices on PostgreSQL and cloud-native infrastructure. Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas at Turbot HQ, cutting policy-code duplication ~60%, and optimized PostgreSQL queries improving audit performance 40%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via templating, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL.

Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, an enterprise SaaS platform; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal distributed microservices.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.

Built a Kafka-based, event-driven distributed pipeline where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for reliable failure handling and reprocessing.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules to event-driven eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff — investigating pod logs and status and collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
